profiles.title: China air quality · 2023
profiles.source_note: China National Environmental Monitoring Centre hourly station observations, summarized from the ObservationHub quality-controlled monthly station product.

variables.name: Ozone (O₃)
variables.method: Each station-month requires valid measurements for at least 75% of UTC hours. The time series shows the median of available station monthly means.

spatial.title: 2023 mean by 2° × 2° grid cell
spatial.notes: Each station contributes its mean across all 12 monthly means. Cell values weight each station equally. Cells with fewer than three stations are omitted.

variables.name: Fine particulate matter (PM₂.₅)
variables.method: Each station-month requires valid measurements for at least 75% of UTC hours. The time series shows the median of available station monthly means.

spatial.title: 2023 mean by 2° × 2° grid cell
spatial.notes: Each station contributes its mean across all 12 monthly means. Cell values weight each station equally. Cells with fewer than three stations are omitted.

profiles.title: Global greenhouse gas concentrations
profiles.source_note: NOAA's Annual Greenhouse Gas Index companion table combines measurements and historical records. This edition was archived by the FaIR reproduction project.

variables.name: Carbon dioxide
variables.method: Global surface dry-air mole fractions derived from NOAA measurements and historical records. The archived estimates are reported by calendar year.

variables.method: Global surface dry-air mole fractions derived from NOAA measurements and historical records. The archived estimates are reported by calendar year.

profiles.title: Surface weather across China
profiles.source_note: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information Integrated Surface Database (ISD-Lite).

variables.name: Air temperature
variables.method: Average readings into three-hour UTC slots. Require at least 75% of a month's slots per station, then give each qualifying station equal weight in the monthly mean.

spatial.title: July 2023 mean air temperature by 2° cell
spatial.notes: July has broad coverage for both variables. Cells average at least three qualifying station means. Locations use the NOAA station history archived through 2019.

distribution.label: Qualifying station-month means (°C)
distribution.notes: Each qualifying station contributes one mean for each month it meets the 75% coverage threshold.

variables.name: Wind speed
variables.method: Average readings into three-hour UTC slots. Require at least 75% of a month's slots per station, then give each qualifying station equal weight in the monthly mean.

spatial.title: July 2023 mean wind speed by 2° cell
spatial.notes: July has broad coverage for both variables. Cells average at least three qualifying station means. Locations use the NOAA station history archived through 2019.

distribution.label: Qualifying station-month means (m/s)
distribution.notes: Each qualifying station contributes one mean for each month it meets the 75% coverage threshold.
